items.text:
Died because of missclicking outside of the ship while wearing no EVA suit
Died because floor patch broke and I had no pressure suit
Died because of getting shanked by two pirates who were sitting in 3x3 m room in the middle of space
Died three times because OKLG-Hauler pilots bought their driving license instead of taking flight lessons
Died because of internal bleeding because nanobots can't heal everything

Overall 11\10 will play again
items.text_zh:
因为没穿EVA宇航服时误点飞船外面而死
因为地板补丁破了而我没有压力服而死
因为被两个坐在太空中间3x3米房间里的海盗捅死
死了三次，因为OKLG-Hauler的飞行员买的是驾照而不是上的飞行课
因为内出血而死，因为纳米机器人不能治愈一切

总体 11\10 还会再玩
